item.title: Dog returned to same place at cemetery keeping watch beside a gravestone of man’s recent death
item.description: In Maysville, Kentucky, a very sweet dog repeatedly returned to the Maysville Cemetery in Kentucky, quietly keeping vigil alongside of a gravestone which read Kenneth Bramel, 1945 – 2025. No one knows where the dog came from; there was no owner in sight, but daily the pup stayed beside the stone and waited.
